entity.name: kaxokaze
entity.description: Independent maintainer of Fellows, an MIT-licensed open-source project exploring peer-first collaboration between autonomous AI agents. Fellows is currently in the design and research stage.

projects.name: Fellows
projects.description: Fellows is an open-source systems research project exploring peer-first collaboration between independent AI agents. It investigates agent-to-agent communication, task negotiation, shared project state, deterministic coordination, controlled execution and verifiable integration. The project is in the design and research stage. There is no runnable runtime, SDK, CLI or benchmark implementation yet.

channels.description: Bank-transfer details for grants, sponsorships, or project contributions are available on request. Contact okay.fellows@gmail.com.

plans.name: One-time project grant or contribution
plans.description: Flexible one-time financial support for Fellows. Funding would support maintainer time, the initial runtime implementation, AI model/API usage, controlled comparative evaluation, and release preparation. Contact okay.fellows@gmail.com for bank-transfer details.

plans.name: Monthly project sponsorship
plans.description: Flexible recurring financial sponsorship to support continued Fellows development, maintainer time, model API usage, and evaluation. Contact okay.fellows@gmail.com for bank-transfer details.

nonFinancialSupport.summary: Fellows is not seeking donations, cash grants, investment, loans or equity financing. The project is seeking practical technical support to help move from research definition toward a small, reproducible prototype.

supportAreas.name: AI model and API access
examples: Access to multiple model families for controlled experiments
supportAreas.intendedUse: Test independent agent sessions and compare peer-first collaboration with single-agent and orchestrated baselines.

supportAreas.name: Compute and infrastructure
supportAreas.intendedUse: Support prototype development, controlled execution and repeatable evaluation runs.

supportAreas.name: Developer tools
examples: Agent tracing, observability, testing and evaluation tools
supportAreas.intendedUse: Make agent activity, state transitions, failures and evaluation results inspectable.

supportAreas.name: Technical and research guidance
supportAreas.intendedUse: Pressure-test the design and define a small, measurable first prototype.

terms: Any access or credits will be scoped to research and used under the provider's terms.
No exclusivity, endorsement or product outcome is implied by a support relationship.
Project status and experimental results will be represented accurately.
nonFinancialSupport.manifestCompatibilityNote: The directory validator requires at least one funding channel and plan. The included channel has no payment address and the only plan is inactive; they are compatibility placeholders, not an active request for money.

disclaimer: This manifest requests financial grants, contributions, and sponsorships through the listed funding plans. It separately records the project's request for AI model/API credits. No GPU, compute, cloud hosting, storage, infrastructure, developer-tool, or mentorship support is being requested. Investment and potential equity arrangements are open for separate discussion and are not an offer of securities.

additionalSupportRequests.scope: Fellows is seeking only AI model/API credits and financial funding.
